_comment: Feature manifest for parity enforcement. Every feature MUST be declared here before shipping.

claim.description: Claim a port for a service

release.description: Release a service and free its port

endpoints.description: Service endpoint URLs and environment variable export. `pd env exec -- <cmd>` additionally resolves pd-secret:// env refs (ADR-0088 Phase B corral) into the child process env only — never to disk.

durable_agent_roster.description: Daemon-minted durable named AgentNode identities with append-only profiles, scoped aliases, session promotion, hybrid expertise retrieval, sanitized handoff memory, and backend-selectable continuation

agent_cockpit.description: Watch + Grab the Wheel (Phase 0) — additive console surface for one agent or spawned run. GET /agents/:id/stream is a single SSE feed merging that agent's lifecycle status, its steering-channel tube/control messages, and its ship-run transcript events into typed envelopes ({v,kind,agentId,body,ts}). POST /agents/:id/interrupt delivers a SOFT cancel/steer signal (a control.interrupt message on the agent's `agent:<id>` steering channel) that a cooperating agent loop can observe — pause/redirect, NOT the hard process kill of DELETE /spawn/:id.
agent_cockpit._note: routes/agent-cockpit.ts. CLI surface is `pd agent stream <id>` (tails the merged SSE feed) and `pd agent interrupt <id> [--reason]` (publishes the soft control.interrupt), handled inside cli/commands/agents.ts handleAgent as subcommands of the existing `agent` top-level command (owned by the `agents` feature, so not re-listed here to avoid a cross-feature duplicate CLI entry). These are real first-class agent consumers, not an MCP-exempt cop-out for the CLI; bijective-parity maps route category `agentcockpit` -> [`agent`]. Bash/zsh/fish completions list `interrupt`/`stream` under the agent subcommand. Steering channel is deterministically agent:<id>, derivable by both the console (stream subscriber) and a cooperating agent loop. SSE idioms mirror routes/messaging.ts + routes/transcripts.ts (hijack, event: connected, 30s :heartbeat, fail-closed cleanup, per-IP SSE limits). transcripts source is optional and self-degrades when the dep is absent.

cartographer.description: Cartographer roadmap progress + atomic claim from the curated pile (ADR-0033) + session/agent linkage (ADR-0034)

resource_governance.description: Read-only resource governance overview for operator UI

daemon._note: Daemon management is CLI-only. `pd dev up/down/list` runs tiered berths (ADR-0084); `pd use`/`pd --daemon` target a berth; GET /whoami reports the daemon's berth identity. `pd upgrade` (ADR-0057 phase 7) checks the latest.json update feed and reports/performs an update.

wait.description: Wait for services to become available

session_phases._note: Phase is set via MCP tool or API, no dedicated CLI command

file_claims.description: Global file claim view across all sessions

integration_signals._note: Routes are messaging routes reused with integration: prefix channels

attention.description: Single-call aggregator of unread inbox + subscribed channel messages for the current agent. Mark-read-on-fetch semantics; --peek leaves cursors in place. Designed to be the first command of every harness session (Claude Code SessionStart hook wires it automatically).

suggestions.description: Suggestibility layer (ADR-0039): durable, dismissible coaching nudges for active agents. This slice ships the claim-overlap detector — when two distinct live sessions hold overlapping claims on one file, both agents get a `claim-overlap-headsup` delivered to their inbox (surfaced by `pd attention`). Deterministic and NLP-free; the semantic topic/prior-art classifier (Primitive 1) is the next slice. Named `pd nudge` to stay distinct from the Tender->operator `pd suggest` queue. The same overlap signal is parley's (ADR-0084) T1 trigger.
suggestions._note: ADR-0039 first slice (claim-overlap-headsup only). Out of scope (next slices): the Haiku/embedding topical classifier (group-chat-proposal, prior-art-doc), the periodic/reactive auto-trigger (today scan is on-demand via `pd nudge scan`), and the per-kind mute CLI surface (route exists; CLI flag deferred).

sugar.description: Compound commands for common workflows (begin/done/whoami) plus cloud account sign-in (pd account, ADR-0101 device flow)

tutorial.description: Interactive tutorial — learn Port Daddy step by step

launch_hints.description: Context-aware startup hints: salvage queue summary and new-folder onboarding nudges

attest.description: Honest self-report + loud-fail invariants (ADR-0045) — pd attest / GET /attest

safe.description: Host-safety layer (ADR-0088) — pd safe scan|baseline|fix|corral|guard / GET /safe/scan / safe_scan. Phase A: read-only secret-at-rest + crown-jewel-perm + binary-trust + egress + MCP-supply-chain scan; opt-in reversible chmod fix. Phase B: `corral` packs a detected secret into the Keychain/broker vault + rewrites the source to a pd-secret:// ref (dry-run default, --apply to write, resolver round-trip verified before rewrite); `guard --staged` scans the staged diff for NEW secrets. Resolve corralled refs at run time with `pd env exec -- <cmd>`.

spawn.description: Spawn AI runs (Ollama, Claude, Gemini, Aider) with Port Daddy coordination and post-run hard budgetUsd cap enforcement from exact telemetry

work.description: Work Intent command family (ADR-0095): adapter conformance probes and capability matrix (binder ch18 Work Order C2)

cockpit.description: App-Native Development Cockpit — read roadmap/recovery markdown into typed mission cards with live coordination cross-ref

popper.description: Autonomous roadmap-to-dispatch task puller — produces dispatch.state='proposed' rows from nightshift-eligible roadmap items. Operator override + FleetBar Nightshift surface via pd popper / HTTP.

recovery.description: Magic-link account recovery — single-use token issue + atomic consume (single-use enforced at the DB layer per proofs/bonded/recovery/magic-link.pv). API-only surface consumed by out-of-band recovery flows.

harbormaster.description: Canonical merge-owning actor body (ADR-0037) — serializes merges of dispatched work, routes conflicts back as sub-dispatches, blocks on branch-protection / CI-red failures. Two-key safety: dispatch.state='accepted' AND merge_queue.state='queued'.

sorties.description: One-shot multi-agent missions (pd sortie run/list/status/logs) plus HTTP record compatibility for historical spawned runs

watch.description: Subscribe to a channel and run a script on each message

fleet.description: Always-on fleet management — daemon auto-starts fleet runners from pd-fleet.yml on boot; hot-reload on config change; resource limits (max_concurrent_spawns, max_spawns_per_hour); lifecycle events on fleet:events channel Includes the ADR-0093 trust-gate approval loop (live WebSocket/SSE stream + decisions; pd fleet approvals/approve/reject) and Web Push registration for approval alerts (pd fleet push).

fleet_hitl_proposals.description: Human-in-the-loop proposal queue for cloud fleet ships: ships submit inert ideas, the operator approves or rejects them in FleetBar/pd-console, and approval hands the proposal to dispatch.
fleet_hitl_proposals._note: Operator-only HITL HTTP surface consumed by FleetBar and pd-console. Ships may submit proposals, but approve/reject is a human decision and not exposed as a routine agent MCP tool.

backend.description: CLI and read API for the fleet backend catalog — list available backends with cost-model framing, switch the forced backend, roll up spend, and report an honest N:N continuation matrix whose declared mechanics stay separate from discovered or daemon-witnessed evidence.

squid.description: Unofficial local Anthropic Messages compatibility bridge for Claude-compatible clients backed by Codex CLI, including model aliases, thinking-effort mapping, local auth, and request-size guards, plus the one-command harness toggle (pd squid on/off), the non-diegetic status/tap readouts, and the PD_SQUID_PILOT visual-identity stamp.

agent-cli-hooks.description: Per-project, daemon-gated Giant Squid coordination hooks for interactive agent CLIs (claude/codex/gemini/agy): pd hooks install/list/uninstall stages gate wrappers under ~/.port-daddy/bin and wires each CLI's native hook config from the shared lib/squid/hook-shape.ts shapes (pd-adr-090).

harbors.description: Named permission namespaces for agent coordination — agents enter/leave harbors and declare capabilities

harbor-ledger.description: Agent Harbor append-only event ledger and disposable projections (roster, transcript timeline, files touched, costs, compliance, work receipts) — binder ch18 Work Order C1, ADR-0095
harbor-ledger._note: C1 shipped the CLI + library slice; the C-routes wave added daemon projections plus the local Surface Gateway WorkIntent command/query ingress in routes/agent-harbor.ts

bonds.description: Bond escrow state machine — daemon escrows money before spawn, refunds on clean exit, slashes on violation. Enforcement half of the cost-tracker/bonds split.

budget_guard.description: Pre-flight canSpawn() + mid-flight onCharge() kill-switch that SIGTERMs live spawns when daily budget is breached. Works in tandem with cost-tracker (observability) and bonds (enforcement).

panic.description: Daemon-wide panic kill-switch. Two-step arm (POST without confirm → POST with confirm:true) SIGTERMs every running spawn and refunds their bonds (operator action, not misbehavior).

benchmark.description: Multi-backend LLM diversity experiment runner (the diversity dividend): run a task corpus across homogeneous and heterogeneous fleet conditions, synthesize via MoA, and score with a rotating blind judge panel

arbiter.description: Runtime invariant enforcement — the sovereign's sword

pheromone.description: Stigmergic evaporation system — agents spray/sniff numeric signals on entities; signals decay over time

merge_queue.description: Ordered merge queue with conflict prediction and orchestrator plugins
merge_queue._note: API-only — accessed via curl or SDK; no CLI commands yet

symbols.description: AST-based symbol extraction, dependency tracking, and conflict prediction
symbols._note: API-only — accessed via curl or SDK; no CLI commands yet

tuples.description: Linda-style tuple space — shared coordination data structure for agent swarms with pattern matching and harbor scoping

blob.description: Content-addressed blob store (Phase 0 tube-as-coordination-substrate). SHA-256 keyed object storage on the filesystem under ~/.port-daddy/blobs/
blob._note: API-only — Phase 0 substrate. CLI/SDK surfaces follow in Phase 1.

booty.description: Artifact harvest provenance over the content-addressed blob store (slice S4a). `pd booty add` content-addresses files via POST /blob and records provenance rows (branch, worktree, session, agent, roadmap link); `pd booty list` and GET /booty read them back.

graph.description: Semantic graph edges and aggregate graph stats for merge queue and symbol-index relationships

embed.description: The one shared local embedding surface (ADR-0061): status/prefetch lifecycle plus text/stdin embedding so skills and matching code reuse the operator's model for hybrid search

skill_graft.description: Native local skill-graft index and operator inspection surface. Fleet ships call lib/skill-graft.ts through lib/fleet-engine.ts; `pd skill-graft` lets agents query, warm, and read guarded references from the same index.

memory.description: Episodic memory, sanitized handoff capsules, UUID- and workspace-bound native-session witnesses, and owner-leased native or cross-harness successor continuation receipts

semantic.description: Embedding-backed semantic resolution stats, review candidates, and nearest-neighbor term search

session_galaxy.description: 2D embedding galaxy of recent agent sessions: MiniLM tail embeddings, seeded t-SNE, k-means clusters with MI term labels; click-through detail and parley initiation.

advisor.description: Deterministic coordination advisor for preflight suggestions across sessions, claims, symbols, salvage, channels, tuples, and locks

coordination_guard.description: Project-local enforcement controls requiring active Port Daddy sessions and matching file claims before commit

coordination_pipeline_audit.description: Coxswain's deterministic comm-pipeline audit. Periodically scans declared+observed channels, agent activity, and tuple keys; emits structured complaints (subscription_coverage, channel_near_duplicate, channel_naming, tuple_naming, silent_agent) with cooldown keys. Borderline cases are flagged needsJudge=true for the LLM judge layer to evaluate. Owned by actor:coxswain.

coordination_judge.description: Backend-agnostic LLM yes/no for the coordination-pipeline audit's borderline cases. Pure transport-injection design: 3s hard timeout, 1h LRU cache, 30/min rate limit, fallback-deny on every failure mode (auth missing, transport error, malformed JSON, timeout). No transport injected → judge stays implicitly disabled. Coxswain stays quiet rather than fire the wrong DM.

llm_call.description: Single source of LLM call infrastructure. Owns the per-backend HTTP adapters (cloudflare, ollama) — both lib/spawner.ts (spawn-shape) and lib/llm-backend-resolver.ts (request-shape) delegate here. Also owns createLLMClient: cache (LRU + TTL) + rolling rate limit + hard timeout (AbortController) + fallback-deny, configurable per actor. Judge is the first consumer; future request-shape actors compose on top with their own ttl/perMinute settings. Spawn-shape callers skip the client wrapper since fleet-engine already does cost-budget kill + per-project rate limiting.

llm_backend_resolver.description: Env cascade for backend selection. options.backend → PD_<ACTOR>_BACKEND → PD_FLEET_DEFAULT_BACKEND → PORT_DADDY_FLEET_DEFAULT_BACKEND → null. Spawn-shape (fleet engine) calls resolveRawBackendName (preserves claude-vs-claude-cli); request-shape (judge + future actors) calls resolveLLMBackend which materializes a transport delegating to lib/llm-call adapters. Per-backend default models come from lib/backend-telemetry-policy's operator tier. fleet-engine.getFleetRuntimeDefaults delegates here so exactly one place reads backend env.

shipwright.description: Project surveyor + fleet authoring assistant. `pd shipwright survey` walks the surveyed project, classifies stack/activity, surfaces risks/opportunities, and writes `.portdaddy/shipwright/survey.json`. Optional --llm augmentation routes through the daemon's LLM client. Propose/apply ship in PR3 commit 3.

suggest.description: Operator-facing suggestion queue fed by Tender ship. `pd suggest` lists pending suggestions; `pd suggest approve <id>` triggers a one-shot ship run; `pd suggest dismiss <id>` clears it. Backed by fleet_suggestions SQLite table.

seamanship.description: Skill registry surface. `pd seamanship list/search/show/sync/outcomes/index` — backed by lib/skill-sync.ts with BM25+Tool2Vec engine in Phase 3. Aliases: pd skills.

fleet_registry.description: Ship health registry written by Tender. GET /fleet/registry returns health scores, Tender recommendations, and pause state per ship. POST /fleet/registry upserts entries. GET /fleet/run/:ship fires a one-shot dispatch.

claim_watcher_snapshots.description: Daemon-side mtime/hash watcher captures prior bytes when a claimed file's content changes mid-claim. `pd snapshots list/show/restore/prune` surfaces those snapshots to operators with one-command rollback. Auto-prune keeps disk usage bounded (default 7 days).

db_backup.description: Durable snapshots of port-registry.db with online-Backup-API atomicity, gzipped artifacts + sha256-verified manifests, and GFS retention. `pd backup` runs a snapshot; `pd backup list/show/prune` inspect and trim. URI-addressed backend interface (file:// in PR-α; s3:// and gcs:// in PR-γ). Encryption-at-rest lands in PR-β. See ADR-0037.

db_restore.description: Restore a port-registry.db snapshot taken by `pd backup`. Live DB is renamed to `<dbPath>.pre-restore-<timestamp>` so the operation is reversible; `PRAGMA integrity_check` auto-rolls back on failure. See ADR-0037.

ideas.description: Canonical ideation trove inspection and dedupe over docs/recovery/IDEAS-TROVE.md with optional local Spark/Spider residue

roadmap.description: Tuple-backed roadmap_items DB-of-record + cartographer roadmap projection. `pd roadmap` reads the table; `pd roadmap upsert/touch` leaves actor-attributed receipts; `POST /roadmap/promote` is the atomic feedback→item linkage cartographer (and humans) call instead of editing docs/ROADMAP.md prose by regex
roadmap._note: Read-side (Next Cuts/feedback/claims projection) routes live under the `cartographer` feature; this feature owns the structured roadmap_items write side

commitments.description: Durable commitments + obligation monitor (ADR-0041): the obligation dual of resurrection. Resurrection watches whether an agent is ALIVE; commitments watch whether it KEPT ITS PROMISE. `due_at` is daemon-derived from the commitment scope (Law 1); `close` refuses without an external oracle ref (Law 2); the monitor is a pure runtime SQLite sweep with no Rust-FFI dependency so it cannot silently degrade (Law 4). `pd commit` creates an obligation, `pd obligations [--overdue]` lists/sweeps, `pd commit close <id> --oracle <ref>` closes against an oracle
commitments._note: ADR-0041 first slice. Out of scope (separate roadmap items / ADRs): graduated-sanction-ladder, accountability-ledger, and non-forgeable actor identity (ADR-0040). owner_actor_id is the self-asserted session/actor id until ADR-0040 lands

quorum.description: Tuple-backed propose/vote primitive for swarm decisions — agents propose roles, others vote, threshold-cross emits a `quorum:passed` tuple subscribers can react to

parley.description: Tuple-backed forced reconciliation primitive for overlapping agents. `pd parley fit` evaluates whether a task deserves multi-agent decomposition; `pd parley call/respond/resolve/list/show` records a bounded SUMMONED→CONVENED→COLLAPSED|ESCALATED|VOIDED dialogue around a contested surface. Turn verbs (`pd parley propose/critique/revise/agree/refuse/say <id> <content>`) are respond sugar with identity inferred from the active session; every turn fans out to the other participants’ inboxes (pd attention), and `pd parley show` records a read receipt so the seen list shows who is behind.

feedback.description: Central agentic-feedback primitive — agents drop structured findings; cartographer (or any subscriber) harvests them into the roadmap. Tuple-backed, harbor-scoped, severity-sorted

cost_tracker.description: LLM cost recording per spawn — model pricing, project budgets, burn rate tracking
cost_tracker._note: Library-only — HTTP surface provided by observability routes module

counters.description: ODS-style time-bucketed operational metrics — in-memory batching with minute/hour rollups
counters._note: Library-only — HTTP surface provided by observability routes module

observability.description: Golden signals (RED method) and aggregated metrics — rate, errors, duration, cost/hr
observability._note: Composite feature — routes module wiring cost-tracker + counters together. API-only (no SDK methods or CLI commands).

cloud_app_telemetry.description: Remote GitHub App / Cloudflare Worker telemetry ingestion and reporting for cloud fleet agents
cloud_app_telemetry._note: API-only telemetry surface consumed by the GitHub App receiver Worker and merged into fleet/agent/cost reporting.

metricsprom.description: Prometheus text exposition + per-route HTTP histograms with outlier ring buffer, skill freshness/distribution gauges, and time-aligned annotation feed (git commits, pd notes, session purposes). Powers the /metrics.html in-house dashboard and any external Prometheus scraper. Replaces the unbounded winston request-log firehose.
metricsprom._note: Browser-served at /metrics.html. /metrics/prom is the Prometheus scrape path (the bare /metrics path is owned by the older info.ts daemon-stats endpoint that the SDK and MCP depend on). /metrics/skills is the JSON skill-distribution audit feeding the dashboard panel and Prometheus gauge export.

usage.description: Local product-usage telemetry for developer-pane diagnostics and operator UX instrumentation
usage._note: API-only telemetry surface consumed by the Fleet Console developer pane.

orchestrator_plugins.description: Hot-swappable merge orchestrator plugins — default FIFO, custom priority/scheduling
orchestrator_plugins._note: Library-only — used internally by merge-queue; no HTTP surface yet

init.description: Project onboarding — scan stack, create fleet, configure MCP, install git hook

setup.description: One-command onboarding — install daemon, configure MCP, install FleetBar, init project
setup._note: CLI plus local daemon onboarding surface — orchestrates daemon install, MCP config, FleetBar install, and project init in one step. Daemon setup routes are loopback-only; mutating actions require a setup capability token from /setup/overview.

cut.description: Cut a release (ADR-0084 Phase 3): build the daemon binary + Rust cdylib + FleetBar.app, collect into dist/release/<version>/, hash each, and write a manifest. Signing (ADR-0057) is opt-in via --sign; an unsigned cut is recorded as such. Verb is `pd cut` (pd release is port release).
cut._note: CLI / CI-only release engineering — a deliberate human or pipeline act, not an agent action, so no daemon routes or MCP surface (MCP_EXEMPT).

batten.description: Declarative release-artifact packing gate. `pd batten verify --staged-dir dist` asserts every artifact declared in release-artifacts.json is present, executable where required, and >= minBytes — collecting ALL failures and exiting nonzero with a per-artifact report (generalizes the scattered per-binary `test -s` asserts). `pd batten imprint` sha256s the sealed cargo into release-imprint.json. Offline (node stdlib only), no daemon.
batten._note: CLI / CI-only release engineering — runs in release.yml against the staged dist/ dir, not an agent action, so no daemon routes or MCP surface (MCP_EXEMPT).

secrets.description: Managed provider secret store — keychain-backed CRUD over allow-listed provider keys (generalizes /fleet/backend-secrets)
secrets._note: Store is the macOS Keychain (encrypted at rest, fail-closed) via lib/keychain.ts. `pd secret set` reads the value from a hidden stdin prompt, never argv (audit finding L1). Reveal returns plaintext for the FleetBar Copy flow and is loopback-only on the daemon (preHandler) plus the global DNS-rebinding guard.

dispatch.description: Operator queue for autonomous feature dev: drop a sentence-shaped goal, daemon routes it to a worker, worker produces a PR, operator accepts/rejects via pd review. Renames pd nightshift (PR #143) onto ADR-0035's 8-state machine. Adds base_branch column for per-base-branch serialization (harbormaster/PR #141 will consume).
dispatch._note: pd nightshift is preserved as a deprecation alias for one minor version. HTTP surface landed in PR #163 (routes/dispatches.ts): propose/list over the dispatch queue. routes/dispatches.ts also serves GET /dispatches/:id and POST /dispatches/:id/{accept,reject,cancel}; those use generic-typed fastify handlers (fastify.get<{Params}>) that the manifest route-parser does not extract, so they are intentionally omitted here to keep the manifest<->code bijection clean.

operator_periscope.description: Operator loop SIGHT stage — pd periscope (aliases sight, scope) raises the periscope in one command: fetches daemon truth from GET /status and renders the current state plus the next recommended cut. Pure read-only glance over existing daemon state; introduces no new route.
operator_periscope._note: Read-only: reuses GET /status (owned by the core status feature). No dedicated route, so routes:[] is intentional — same pattern as coordination_guard.

operator_coast_guard.description: Coast Guard read path — pd coast-guard status (alias cg) shows the operator whether spawned agents are confined on this machine (the OS sandbox mechanism in force), plus the secret broker, dotenv denial, hard egress cap, and the protected directories. Pure local read-only legibility over ADR-0050; introduces no new route.
operator_coast_guard._note: Read-only local capability read (computed from lib/coast-guard.ts, no daemon round-trip). Route + MCP follow on the same coastGuardStatus() accessor — same read-only pattern as operator_periscope.

transcripts.description: Fleet ship-run transcript records — operator-facing surface for inspecting what a spawned worker did, what it cost, and its produced outputs. Read views (list/show/cost/stream) plus a delete for pruning old runs.
transcripts._note: Surfaced by pd transcripts (singular alias: pd transcript). routes/transcripts.ts is the HTTP API the FleetBar/dashboard ship-run views read from.

context_health.description: Agent context-window health and per-task token ledger — swarm-wide budget visibility (ADR-0048 P1/P3)

harvest.description: Session note → episode promotion (Knowledge Custodian harvest duty, ADR-0048 P2/P3)

custodian.description: Knowledge Custodian — daemon-resident compaction engine and operator permission learning (ADR-0048 P3)
custodian._note: Phase 3 knowledge custodian. routes/custodian.ts, lib/knowledge-custodian.ts, lib/operator-permissions.ts.

relay.description: Cloud relay — zero-trust event fabric for cross-machine pub/sub (ADR-0049)
relay._note: Relay Worker in apps/relay/. Daemon routes in routes/relay.ts. CLI in cli/commands/relay.ts. lib/relay-client.ts manages outbound SSE. Subcommands: relay url <url>|--clear, relay status, relay exchange.

visual_tasks.description: Visual issue intake from FleetBar and the Port Daddy Scout Chrome extension. Persists screenshots, captures DOM hints, routes to local/cloud fleet targets, and opens reviewable work items without exposing dispatch internals.
visual_tasks._note: API-only operator surface for browser/FleetBar visual issue capture. Extension lives in apps/pd-scout-extension/.

whois.description: Semantic agent-directory / skill-router — ranks agents and humans by capability match × heartbeat freshness
